prompt.rendered: Design a printed circuit board for a battery-powered I2C sensor node: a microcontroller in a quad flat package, a 3.3V LDO regulator, an I2C sensor in a SOIC-8 package, two I2C pull-up resistors, at least three decoupling/bulk capacitors, and a 4-pin power/programming header — at least ten footprints total. Board outline at most 45mm × 35mm, two copper layers. Declare nets VIN, 3V3, GND, SDA, SCL, and the two programming signals; the sensor and MCU share the I2C bus with pull-ups to 3V3, and every power pin gets a decoupling capacitor. Place all components and route every net so its copper is fully connected. The board must pass a design-rule check clean. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
